data.one_liner: Throttling and debouncing async helper classes with listeners in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides throttling and debouncing utility classes to control the rate at which asynchronous actions or functions are executed. The classes extend Stream<bool> and implement Sink<Function> for integration.
use_when: You need to limit how often a function can be called, such as handling button clicks or window resize events
You need to debounce user input like search queries
avoid_when: You already use reactive streams or libraries like RxDart that handle debouncing and throttling natively
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on throttling and debouncing
